page.overview:
Who is Candy Elemental?

This unnamed Candy Elemental embodied the Element of Candy during Patience St. Pim's era, or the pre-Mushroom War era. He, like his fellow Elementals (save for St. Pim), accepted his fate of being destroyed by the Lich.

This Candy Elemental appears to have been an African-American Human male before his skin turned pink as a result of his Elemental powers manifesting.
